test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3
solution:
The correct answer is, **'industries**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Industry** means **a place where raw materials and manufacturing goods are processed as a finished product or a raw material for other products**.

 
 
• Example, ***the government has many policies that help and assist various industries in the country.***
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, **In rural areas, agriculture is the chief source of livelihood along with fishing, cottage industries, pottery, etc.***** ***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Industrialist** is*** *****a person who owns or manages an industry**.

 
 
• Example,*** Robin is a visionary industrialist.***
 
 
 
• **Industriousness** means **hardworking**.
 
 
• Example, ***Brisbane is an industriousness city***.
 
 
 
• **Industrial **means **related to an industry.**
 
 
• Example, ***coal is an industrial material***.
